cases.title: A continuing responsibility
cases.body: Ongoing ownership of the website inside an enterprise marketing team: Webflow and CMS across launches and campaigns, analytics that get trusted before spend, consent that behaves, schema the engines parse.
cases.chain: problem: no owner across seams → move: single-operator coverage → result: site holds shape between teams → limits: numbers shared on request
cases.attribution: sole operator: platform, analytics, consent, schema

cases.title: A campaign, in context
cases.body: Campaign pages for a contract-management business where measurement kept breaking at the edges: consent discipline and embed QA so the data survives the campaign.
cases.chain: problem: measurement broke at the edges → move: consent + embed discipline → result: clean data survives campaigns → limits: baseline pre-dates tooling
cases.attribution: sole operator: consent architecture, tracking QA

cases.title: A portfolio with a common structure
cases.body: A property portfolio of one-off pages rebuilt as a single publishing system: shared CMS architecture with schema and answer-shaped content that search and AI engines parse.
cases.chain: problem: one-off pages decayed → move: CMS as system + schema @graph → result: machine-quotable structure → limits: quoted volume still accruing
cases.attribution: sole operator: CMS architecture, schema design

principles.title: Clarity of purpose.
principles.body: The job, the buyer, and the constraint named before anything gets built. The site knows what it is for; the team can repeat it in one sentence.

principles.title: Judgement in context.
principles.body: Every decision tied to the brand, the buyer, and the number it is meant to move. If nothing measurable changes, the work is not done.

principles.title: Room to grow.
principles.body: Tokens, sections, and CMS structure built for the next campaign and the next market, so a new page costs an afternoon instead of a redesign.

exhibits.title: The system, with reasons on
exhibits.body: Toggle the reason layer: every section carries its why.

exhibits.body: An interactive seed study, with a repeatable draw. The original engine port and published logbook remain separate work.
